environment.description: ECS Fargate service in a private subnet behind an internal NLB. The NLB target group has proxy protocol v2 enabled and the NLB itself has no public DNS. Ingress is controlled by a VPC security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) attached to the NLB ENIs that permits TCP/443 only from three specific CIDR prefixes: 10.20.0.0/16 (internal microservices VPC peering), 172.16.4.0/22 (corporate VPN egress), and 192.168.100.0/24 (CI/CD runners). The SQS queue access policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to a condition key aws:SourceVpce matching vpce-0ab3c7f912e4d (the interface VPC endpoint in the services VPC). Additionally, the SQS queue has a redrive policy with maxReceiveCount=3 and a DLQ for malformed messages. The upstream producer Lambda runs within the same VPC and validates message attribute lengths (max 128 chars per attribute, alphanumeric plus hyphens only) before enqueueing via the VPC endpoint.

config.vpc_endpoint: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs interface endpoint in private subnet
config.producer_validation: Lambda validates attributes: max 128 chars, regex [a-zA-Z0-9\-]+ enforced before SendMessage
config.dns: No public DNS resolution for NLB or SQS endpoint
